name: Citi® / AAdvantage® Platinum Select® World Elite Mastercard®

localized_names.en: Citi® / AAdvantage® Platinum Select® World Elite Mastercard®

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: $0 intro annual fee for the first 12 months of account opening, then $99

apr.notes: The variable APR for purchases and balance transfers is 19.49% – 29.49%, based on your creditworthiness. The variable APR for cash advances is 29.74%. The variable Penalty APR is up to 29.99%. Minimum interest charge is $0.50. Cash advance fee – either $10 or 5% of the amount of each cash advance, whichever is greater. Balance transfer fee – either $5 or 5% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater.

base_rate.description: Earn 1 AAdvantage® mile for every $1 spent on all other purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: Earn 1 Loyalty Point for every 1 eligible AAdvantage® mile earned from purchases to reach AAdvantage® status faster.

signup_bonus.description: LIMITED-TIME OFFER: Earn 80,000 American Airlines AAdvantage® bonus miles plus travel benefits. Bonus miles earned after $3,500 in purchases within the first 4 months of account opening.

benefits.title: First checked bag free
benefits.description: Your first checked bag is free on domestic American Airlines itineraries for you and up to four companions traveling with you on the same reservation, a savings of up to $500 per round trip.

benefits.title: Preferred boarding
benefits.description: Enjoy preferred boarding on American Airlines flights.

benefits.title: Save 25% on inflight food and beverage purchases
benefits.description: 25% savings on inflight food and beverage purchases on American Airlines flights when you use your credit card.

benefits.title: $125 American Airlines Flight Discount
benefits.description: Earn a $125 American Airlines Flight Discount after you spend $20,000 or more in purchases during your cardmembership year and renew your credit card.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: Shop like a local wherever you go with your Citi® / AAdvantage® Platinum Select® credit card.

benefits.title: Add authorized users
benefits.description: Earn more AAdvantage® miles with purchases made by authorized user cards added to your account at no additional charge.

benefits.title: Special Offer: Up to $180 back on Turo
benefits.description: Earn up to $30 in statement credits for each eligible Turo trip completed from October 19, 2025 to October 18, 2026, up to $180 statement credits in total. To qualify, you must link your card to your Turo account on Turo.com/AAdvantagePlatinum and pay for the trip with your card.

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: First checked bag free on domestic American Airlines itineraries for you and up to 4 companions (savings up to $500 per round trip)
other: Preferred boarding on American Airlines flights
Save 25% on inflight food and beverage purchases on AA flights
$125 AA Flight Discount after $20,000 spend/year and card renewal
Up to $180 back on Turo (Oct 19 2025 – Oct 18 2026)

notes: Verified from official product page on 2026-07-24. All fees, APR, rewards, and benefits extracted from page text. Signup bonus is a limited-time offer (80,000 miles vs standard 50,000).
